items.summary: Approve the three isolated preview-only scaffold changes with tightened technical gates. Work must remain in separate review worktrees and preview artifacts, with no production publish, deployment, credential/configuration change, dependency addition, analytics activation, affiliate setup, external spend, or cross-site shared runtime behavior. Acceptance requires deterministic build, link, accessibility, metadata, and preview smoke checks; an explicit launch-gate artifact; and a reversible isolated commit. Do not claim readiness, revenue, ROI, causal lift, or production safety. Preserve the production gate because launch-readiness, operations, and security evidence remain incomplete.

Technical disposition: queue admission is safe only for preview artifacts on complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. The current evidence does not support public exposure: analytics are unconfigured, one site fails compliance checks, one is unreachable, and operations/fleet-doctor evidence is unavailable. Preview validation may document failures as blockers; it must not remediate production, enable telemetry, or infer missing metrics.
